title: Treasury

authority.scope: metadata-only public-surface inventory; not runtime readiness evidence
non_claims: No live bank connectivity, bank API call, SWIFT/host-to-host transport, or payment execution.
No durable persistence, Postgres/RLS, Workflow execution, accounting ledger mutation, statutory filing, runtime audit-chain emission, or cloud deployment.
No SAP, Oracle, or treasury workstation exhaustive parity claim.
authority.runtime_inventory_boundary: Legacy runtime-looking sections below are preserved only as planning inventory. They are not current implementation, deployment, runtime audit-chain, persistence, SLO/DR, GA, production-readiness, or live bank/payment evidence.

keystone_adr_field_roster.self_modification: no autonomous self-modification; evidence artifacts only
keystone_adr_field_roster.marketplace: Marketplace settles all tenant deals per ADR-0314; this service records settlement refs only
keystone_adr_field_roster.time_coordination: HLC default; TrueTime-compatible external evidence accepted when source system supplies it
keystone_adr_field_roster.transport: HTTP/3 default; fallback HTTP/2 then HTTP/1.1; TLS 1.3; ECH advertised; PQC hybrid offered where supported
keystone_adr_field_roster.deployment_shape: planning inventory only: Kubernetes plus Cloud Hypervisor/Kata-compatible isolation is not a current treasury cloud deployment claim
keystone_adr_field_roster.intelligence_dispatch: library-first when local binding exists; network-opt-in for model-backed analysis
keystone_adr_field_roster.ontology_read_path: library-first projections with freshness_floor per bounded context
observability: audit-chain event names (planning inventory only; no runtime audit-chain emission)
keystone_adr_field_roster.consent: per-purpose only when user-facing flows collect personal data
keystone_adr_field_roster.deliverability: no direct mail-emitting ownership unless a pack overlay activates notifications through mail/connect
keystone_adr_field_roster.platform_owner_indirection: no hard-coded owner name in public contract fields
keystone_adr_field_roster.minor_protection: refuse or route minor-targeted flows through pack policy
keystone_adr_field_roster.meta_trust_attestation: required only for Foundry-touching generated artifacts
keystone_adr_field_roster.bootstrap_trust_chain: SPIFFE plus kill-switch for bootstrap-tier surfaces
keystone_adr_field_roster.credential_isolation: OpenBao dynamic secrets with <=60s TTL or sidecar isolation
keystone_adr_field_roster.abuse_defence: anti-bot, anti-spoof, anti-scrape with UX floor and emergency-services bypass
